chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurara, from Humran, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who bought a slave girl: Can he have sexual intercourse with her before the period of gestation (istibra') is completed and she has not been cleared? He (peace be upon him) said: Yes, when the obligation is established for her and she becomes part of his wealth. So if she dies, she is from his wealth.
ai.seo_question: Can a man have intercourse with a newly purchased slave girl before her istibra' period is complete?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the juristic principle of 'istibra'' for slave girls, permitting immediate sexual consummation upon purchase as long as the right of ownership is established, thereby resolving the issue of potential prior pregnancy. It underscores the property rights aspect of slavery in Shia fiqh, noting that the slave girl is considered part of the owner's wealth, with her value retained by the owner even if she dies. This ruling reflects the practical legal considerations of the time regarding lineage verification and asset management within the household.
